transformations.convention: Use the FSO 2020 current-price GDP observation as the chain-linked volume anchor because the reference year is 2020; compound published annual real growth backward and forward. Preserve the 1995 historical-accounting break and source statuses.
Divide annual real GDP in CHF millions by the permanent-resident population at 31 December, converting millions of CHF to CHF per person. The denominator is end-of-period, not an annual average.

Arithmetic mean of the twelve unadjusted monthly total jobless-rate observations from the same SNB/SECO vintage. Derive only complete calendar years; do not create a partial 2026 annual value. Preserve the full source precision before calculating.

10Y minus 3M annual-average yields in percentage points for matched completed years. Exclude 2026: long Jan–Aug and short Jan–Sep are different observation windows. Subtract stored three-decimal input values.
